title: SMTP: port 465 implicit TLS (SMTPS) for submission
description: STARTTLS on port 587 is unavoidable for MTA-to-MTA on port 25 (the wider email world mandates it). For client submission, port 465 (SMTPS, implicit TLS) is the modern standard and avoids the STARTTLS upgrade state machine. Add a smtps.addr config option alongside the existing plaintext listen addr. When set, listen with implicit TLS on 465. AUTH PLAIN/LOGIN (1c8.6) then works on the SMTPS port only. Port 587+STARTTLS can remain for compatibility but should not be the recommended submission path in documentation.
